product.name: Aurelio SafeView 3D Goggles
product.description: Aurelio SafeView 3D Goggles provide comprehensive protection for laboratory personnel. The goggles feature a wide 20‑cm lens area constructed from high‑impact polycarbonate, ensuring clarity while resisting scratches. A flexible silicone gasket creates a secure seal around the face, preventing chemical splashes from entering. The lightweight 0.4‑kg frame is ergonomically shaped for extended wear, and the adjustable strap accommodates a range of head sizes. Designed for use with standard 50‑mm lens mounts, the goggles are compatible with most laboratory eyewear accessories. Ideal for chemistry labs, biology research, and any environment where eye safety is paramount.
